about.intro_content: Prof. Yan-Fang Li is a Professor in the Department of Gynecologic Oncology at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, specialising in gynecologic surgical oncology.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Li practises within SYSUCC's Department of Gynecologic Oncology, one of China's leading centres for the surgical and comprehensive treatment of gynecologic malignancies, including cervical, ovarian and endometrial cancer.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Yan-Fang Li

items.question: Does Prof. Yan-Fang Li accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to gynecologic cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Li's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Li specialises in gynecologic surgical oncology, treating cervical, ovarian and endometrial cancer.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: What department does Prof. Li work in at SYSUCC?
items.answer: Prof. Li is a Professor in SYSUCC's Department of Gynecologic Oncology, which treats cervical, ovarian, endometrial and other gynecologic malignancies.
